summary: Canada Goose Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its fourth quarter and full year fiscal 2026 financial results. The filing includes unaudited revenue figures, operating income, and adjusted EBIT, along with non-IFRS measures and business highlights such as product launches and brand campaigns. The registrant also provides forward-looking guidance for fiscal 2027 with expected revenue growth of low-single digits and adjusted EBIT margin of 11% to 12%. This is a routine earnings release and does not constitute a special situation; it contains no acquisition, divestiture, or corporate action triggering a reclassification.
